summary: Fix stale venvs cleanup false positives from atime and unexcluded metadata

delivery.outcome: Fix stale venvs cleanup false positives by relying on mtime instead of atime for staleness, excluding non-source metadata/governance files from project activity measurement, and filtering non-user/zombie processes during active path collection.
nonGoals: No cleanup is executed on user projects during implementation.
No candidate with a project or environment tree observation error, recent mtime activity, symlink, missing virtualenv marker, or known active process is removed.
No change to fixos-native protocol structure.

architecture.decision: Use modification time (mtime_ns) for virtual environment and project source activity checks instead of volatile access time (atime_ns). Define PROJECT_SOURCE_EXCLUDE to omit VCS (.git), IDE (.idea, .vscode, .cursor), daemon telemetry (.planfile, .koru, .governance, .subactor, .nlp2dsl), and globally synced governance files (.aider.conf.yml, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, .github). Filter zombie and foreign-user processes in active_paths() to avoid spurious AccessDenied errors.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-055 source and regression-test changes.

commands: OneDev protected CI and independent Validator against the frozen exact head
